item.title: Change in primary voting rules leads to confusion in 2 Texas counties as voters are turned away
item.description: A rule change for primary voting in two Texas counties led to mass voter confusion that eventually led to a state supreme court ruling, threats of more legal action and the potential that an untold number of voters could find themselves disenfranchised. item.title: Asian shares swoon and Kospi sinks 12%, as the war with Iran widens and oil surges higher
item.description: Asian shares have swooned, with South Korea's benchmark plunging more than 12%, after a global sell-off for stocks hit Wall Street. Oil prices climbed still higher. Worries over the widening war have hammered most world markets. U.S. futures were down 0.4%. On Tuesday, the S&P 500 finished with a loss of 0.9% after dropping as much as 2.5% on concerns over the war's damage to the economy. item.title: US soldiers were killed in Iranian drone strike on operations center at Kuwait civilian port
item.description: An operations center targeted by an Iranian drone strike that killed six American soldiers was located in a civilian port in Kuwait, more than 10 miles away from the main Army base. That's according to satellite images and a U.S. official.
